notes:
{蛇|へび} refers to snakes, legless reptiles.

KANJI READING:
Also read as ⟦じゃ→じゃ：03040_ja⟧ in compounds (e.g., ⟦{大蛇|だいじゃ}→大蛇：noentry⟧, ⟦{蛇口|じゃぐち}→蛇口：04218_jaguchi⟧)

ZODIAC:
⟦{巳|み}→巳：noentry⟧ (snake) is the sixth animal of the Chinese zodiac. People born in the Year of the Snake are called ⟦{巳年|みどし}→巳年：noentry⟧⟦{生|う}まれ→生まれ：01867_umare⟧.

TYPES OF SNAKES:
- ⟦{毒蛇|どくへび}→毒蛇：20943_dokuhebi⟧: venomous snake
- ⟦{青大将|あおだいしょう}→青大将：noentry⟧: Japanese rat snake (common, non-venomous)
- ⟦マムシ→マムシ：noentry⟧: pit viper (venomous)

IDIOMS AND EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{蛇足|だそく}→蛇足：15805_dasoku⟧: superfluous addition (literally 'snake legs')
- {蛇|へび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{蛇|へび}: it takes one to know one
- ⟦{竜頭蛇尾|りゅうとうだび}→竜頭蛇尾：06119_ryuutoudabi⟧: anticlimactic ending (dragon head, snake tail)

RELATED WORDS:
⟦{蛇口|じゃぐち}→蛇口：04218_jaguchi⟧ (faucet/tap) contains the kanji for snake but refers to a water tap.
